# Aqua Element

> Aqua Element is a premium artesian drinking-water brand operated by Blue Stream Group, serving Tashkent and the Tashkent Region in Uzbekistan. Water is sourced from a deep artesian well, processed through an 11-step filtration system, and re-mineralized to deliver a balanced, naturally tasting drinking water. We sell two consumer SKUs — a 10-litre bottle and an 18.9-litre (19-litre standard) returnable bottle — direct to homes, offices, and via subscription, with same-day delivery across Tashkent.

## What we sell

- **18.9 L (19 L) returnable bottle** — the standard cooler-compatible bottle for offices and home water dispensers. Sold per-bottle and via recurring subscription. Returnable PET/polycarbonate; we collect the empty on the next delivery.
- **10 L bottle** — smaller-format option for kitchens, individuals, and households without a cooler. Same source water, same 11-step process.

Both products are pure artesian water with controlled mineralization — no flavorings, no carbonation, no additives.

## Our 11-step filtration & mineralization process

1. Artesian source water intake from a deep well (deeper than municipal infrastructure).
2. Coarse mechanical pre-filtration (sediment removal).
3. Activated carbon filtration (chlorine, taste, odor compounds).
4. Iron and manganese removal.
5. Water-softening stage (controlled hardness reduction).
6. Fine 5-micron sediment polishing.
7. Reverse osmosis membrane purification.
8. UV sterilization.
9. Ozone disinfection.
10. Controlled mineralization (re-introduces calcium, magnesium, and trace minerals to natural artesian-water levels).
11. Final 1-micron polish + hot-fill bottling under HACCP-aligned conditions.

The result: lab-tested water with TDS, pH, and mineral profile that match the cleanest natural artesian sources, while removing every contaminant a deep-well source could carry.
